pull.title: fix(hrm): fault fairness and shared privacy sink completion
pull.body:
## Result
Continues the existing HRM completion candidate with bounded shared privacy fixes across auth/RLS, Prisma audit diagnostics, Pino and all Sentry runtimes. Existing fault/fairness, restore/auth probes and accepted Support/main integration remain preserved.

Current exact head: `2d723e02627d2983db91b1d2360fd7592f886e8b`; tree: `5d1f81a8c306e1d07f22f25f248b206882aabc5e`; integrated main: `5c7412266c29a53e12963621b090c4f1aee95a3a`.

## Shared privacy change
- Fixed operation-only auth/audit failures and finite RLS diagnostics; same authentication, tenant, response, downstream throw and best-effort audit behavior.
- Real Pino serialization filters free messages/errors and sanitizes every child before construction. Support/Routes safe observation contracts remain.
- Sentry filters bounded event/transaction payloads and envelopes before integration startup. Replay, BrowserSession and unsupported envelope channels are disabled/dropped; `infer_ip=never` is retained. Diagnostic detail and error grouping are intentionally reduced.
- No new collection, destinations, permissions, schema, baseline or workflow changes.

Details: [bounded scope and remaining criteria](https://github.com/rashadoni/leaddrive-v2/blob/2d723e02627d2983db91b1d2360fd7592f886e8b/docs/workforce-shared-privacy-2026-10-06.md).

## Validation
- Root final local regression: 386 PASS / 0 FAIL / 0 SKIP, 23 files.
- Independent: 41 new tests and 98 compatibility tests PASS; all 8,797 blobs/modes and 2,811 trees verified, 21 deltas / 8,776 preserved parent blobs.
- Scoped production+test typing clean; new/touched targeted lint clean except 6 identical existing parent auth/Prisma diagnostics. No baseline suppression.
- Independent source receipt SHA256: `dd11e532b620b8ad88fde5a9c3e03e35a6f67a416018af1458bdf46fedc5d8b6`. Initial Pino-child and Sentry-init failures remain separate historical evidence.
- Fresh exact-head hosted checks and labeled Linux production build: **PENDING**. Prior-head green checks are not reused.

## Preserved acceptance and limits
Accepted previous `b896cdb` fault/fairness evidence remains immutable: [terminal archive](https://github.com/rashadoni/leaddrive-v2/blob/2d7c8c90e7d385f021cb8f13de31c383b005aca4/docs/evidence/workforce-fault-fairness-2026-10-06/terminal/README.md).

Live destination/retention/ACL/collector/native-driver coverage, staging and signed-device criteria remain open. Historical `api_keys` schema is not invented. WF-C10-011 stays PLANNED; WF-C12-002/WF-C12-008 stay PARTIAL. Ledger unchanged: 82/161 DONE, 79 open, weighted 59%.

**No merge, deploy or activation.**
